remarks: The townhome you've been waiting for in downtown Greenwich. Walk to the train, parks, and all the shops and restaurants along Greenwich Avenue from this beautifully laid-out 2-bedroom, 2-full-bath residence with an attached garage. The main level offers a welcoming family room with wet bar and powder room-ideal for entertaining or relaxing at home. Upstairs, enjoy a spacious open-concept living and dining area that opens to a private outdoor terrace with room to dine and grill. The large eat-in kitchen and powder room add everyday convenience. The primary suite features a renovated bath, walk-in closets, and access to the back patio. A second en-suite bedroom completes this exceptional townhome offering.
